strict_events.evidence: Public Suspilne Chernihiv feed shows a Chernihiv-district alert, then explosions heard in Chernihiv and an AFU warning of UAVs over the north and south of the city, before the all-clear.
A new Chernihiv-district alert is followed by multiple explosions heard in Chernihiv; the same feed later reports Russian strikes on critical infrastructure in the city.
During the Chernihiv-district alert, Suspilne correspondents reported repeated explosions in Chernihiv and the MVA said the city was under a mass Russian attack.
The Chernihiv-district alert was followed by an AFU UAV warning toward Chernihiv and a reported UAV hit on an enterprise in the north of Chernihiv before the all-clear.
